name: ari-readiness-site

scripts.build:all: rm -rf public_build && cd report && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p public_build/report public_build/research public_build/reports public_build/evidence && cp -r report/dist/. public_build/report/ && cp index.html dental.html methodology.html improve.html robots.txt sitemap.xml BingSiteAuth.xml llms.txt public_build/ && cp research/index.html research/thanks.html research/ari_report_2026_free.html public_build/research/ && cp -r reports/. public_build/reports/ && cp evidence/index.html public_build/evidence/ && cp *.webp *.png public_build/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -r assets public_build/
